text: This is the same street. The same corner where, one ordinary afternoon, everyone vanished.
Trees now grow straight out of the road. Their roots lift the asphalt, and the cars beneath them are slowly rusting away.
Most of the windows are gone. Ivy climbs the walls, and every storm pulls a little more of the city down.
And this is not just imagination.
In nineteen eighty-six, the city of Pripyat was abandoned in a single day. Today, forest grows through its streets, and trees stand inside its buildings.
No engines. No voices. Only wind, birds, and the slow sound of a city returning to the earth.
After just twenty-five years... would anyone still recognize this as a city?
